king_of_serpents.description: Your [Dragon] allies also receive the buff when you cast this spell.

reaction_cast.name: Reaction Cast
reaction_cast.description: Casts your Petrify spell on enemies instead.

Deals [12_arcane:arcane] and [12_fire:fire] damage in a [7_tile:radius] line perpendicular to the caster.
Melts walls in the affected area.

mirror.name: Dual Blazerip
mirror.description: Blazerip also affects a symmetric area behind the player.

aether_poison.name: Aether Poison
aether_poison.description: Inflicts Aether Poison on units it hits. Aether Poison lasts [10:duration] turns, and deals [1_arcane:damage] damage per turn, and causes the enemy to lose 50 [arcane] resistance during the duration.

blazebugs.name: Blazebugs
blazebugs.description: On kill, summon a swarm of either Fae Flies or Burning Flies.

description.en:
[Blind] all units in line of sight of the caster for [4_turns:duration].
[Blind] units have all their spell ranges reduced to 1.
Deals [5_holy:holy] damage to affected [undead] and [demon] units.

inflict_stun.name: Halting Light
inflict_stun.description: Deals [1_turn:duration] of stun to all enemy units.

deal_fire.name: Searing Light
deal_fire.description: Deals [5_fire:fire] damage to all enemy units in LOS.

quick_cast.name: Quickcast
quick_cast.description: Casting Blinding Light only takes half a turn

description.en: Teleport to target tile.

requires_los.name: Blindcasting
requires_los.description: Blink can be cast without line of sight

thunder.name: Thunderblink
thunder.description: Casting blink casts thunderstrike on the [2:num_targets] closest enemy targets in line of sight.

Enemies in a [4_tile:radius] burst take [18_dark:dark] damage.
Whenever an enemy is dealt damage this way, you or a random wounded ally in the targeted area is healed for half that amount.

toxicity.name: Toxic Shift
toxicity.description: Bloodshift also deals [poison] damage, though this damage does not cause healing.

greed.name: Blood Greed
greed.description: You and only you are healed by this spell, even if you are out of the targeted area.

description.en:
Fire an arcing bolt of electricity dealing [12_lightning:lightning] damage.
The bolt repeatably arcs to new targets within the cascade range.
Each arc deals damage to all units along a beam.
The bolt can arc up to [5_tiles:cascade_range], and cannot pass through walls.
The bolt terminates when it cannot arc to any new targets.

chain_fireball.name: Chain Fireball
chain_fireball.description: Cast Fireball for free on each target chain lightning bounces to

weathercraft.name: Cloud Conductance
weathercraft.description: Chain Lightning can arc to blizzards, rain clouds, and storm clouds

shield.name: Lightning Shield
shield.description:
Chain Lightning can arc to friendly targets.
Friendly units hit by Chain Lightning gain 1 SH, up to a max of 3, instead of damaged.

description.en:
Summons a choir of [4:num_summons] angelic singers.
The singers have [10_HP:minion_health], [1_SH:shields], 50% resistance to [fire] and [holy] damage, and 100% resistance to [dark] damage.
The angels can sing, dealing [2_fire:fire] and [2_holy:holy] damage to all [undead], [demon], and [dark] units in a [5_tile:radius] radius. [Living] and [holy] units in the song's radius are healed for [1_HP:heal].
The angels vanish after [10:minion_duration] turns.

cast_deathbolt.name: Dual Angels
cast_deathbolt.description: Angels can cast your Death Bolt on a 4 turn cooldown.

conversion.name: Mercy
conversion.description: When an enemy is healed for a cumulative total more than its max health, it becomes an ally.

description.en:
Each turn, [blind] all units for [1_turn:duration].
[Blind] units have all their spell ranges reduced to 1.
Lasts [5_turns:duration]

darkvision.name: Darkvision
darkvision.description: Doesn't blind you or your allies

deal_clouds.name: Dark Clouds
deal_clouds.description: Deal [5_dark:dark] damage to all enemies under clouds each turn.

Deal [11_dark:dark] damage to the target each turn for [5_turns:duration].
If the target dies during this time, deals [11_ice:ice] damage and inflicts [frozen] for [5_turns:duration] on all enemies within a [3_tile:radius] radius.
[Frozen] units cannot act. Frozen units unfreeze upon taking [fire] or [physical] damage.

raise_skeleton.name: Icy Necromancy
raise_skeleton.description: Raise slain [living] units as Icy Skeletons.

deal_poison.name: Slaughter Chill

mass_deathchill.name: Mass Death Chill
mass_deathchill.description: Applies Death Chill to a connected group of enemies.

control.name: Controlled Appetite
control.description: Instead of killing the target, only steal as much HP as you are missing.

heal_allies.name: Mass Feeding
heal_allies.description: Also heal allies in a 2 tile radius.

charred_flesh.name: Charred Flesh
charred_flesh.description: Slain Living units are raised as Burning Skeletons.

Deal [24_arcane:arcane] and [24_dark:dark] damage to an enemy unit.
Then, if the target is under 50% HP, deal that damage again.
If this kills the target, they are raised as a zombie.
Can only target [living], [demon], and [arcane] units.

horde_mode.name: Horde Mode
horde_mode.description: Zombies raised by this spell can cast it on a 7 turn cooldown.

gluttony.name: Gluttony
gluttony.description: If Devour Mind kills the target, heal for the half the target's max HP

brain_freeze.name: Brain Freeze
brain_freeze.description:
Devour Mind deals [ice] damage in addition to [arcane] and [dark].
If the target lives, they are [frozen:ice] for [3:duration] turns.
Additionally, each of their abilities gains +[3:duration] cooldown.

hp_threshold.name: HP Threshold
hp_threshold.description: Increase the maximum HP units which can be targeted

check_cur_hp.name: Brute Force
check_cur_hp.description: Dominate targets based on current hp instead of maximum hp.

make_lich.name: Undead Servitude
make_lich.description: Transforms the target into a lich.

cult_leader.name: Cult Leader
cult_leader.description: Dominated targets gain your Dominate spell on a 30 turn cooldown.

Summon an Earth Elemental.
Earth elementals have [120_HP:minion_health], [50_physical:physical] resist, [50_fire:fire] resist, [50_lightning:lightning] resist, and cannot move.

earthquake_totem.name: Earthquake Totem
earthquake_totem.description: Earthen Sentinel gains your Earthquake spell on a 3 turn cool down.

stinging_totem.name: Stinging Totem
stinging_totem.description: Earthen Sentinel gains your Poison Sting spell.

holy_totem.name: Holy Totem
holy_totem.description: Earthen Sentinel gains your Heavenly Blast spell on a 2 turn cool down.

Whenever you cast a [fire] spell, summon a fire elemental at the target of that spell.
Fire elementals have [22_HP:minion_health], [100_fire:fire] resist, [50_physical:physical] resist, and [-50_ice:ice] resist.

cast_eye.name: Eye Gate
cast_eye.description: Your elementals instantly cast your Eye of Fire spell when summoned

starfire_summon.name: Starfire Gate
starfire_summon.description: Starfire Gate can sustain off of both [Fire] and [Arcane] spells. Starfire Gate summons Starfire Elementals instead of Fire Elementals.

searing_gate.name: Searing Gate
searing_gate.description:
Deal [1:damage] [fire] damage to enemy units in a [1_tile:radius] radius around you each turn.
This radius increases by 1 each time you cast a [fire] spell.

description.en:
Summon a frostfire hydra.
The hydra has [16_HP:minion_health], and is stationary.
The hydra has a beam attack which deals [7_fire:fire] damage with a [9_tile:minion_range] range.
The hydra has a beam attack which deals [7_ice:ice] damage with a [9_tile:minion_range] range.
The hydra vanishes after [15_turns:minion_duration].

crystal_eyes.name: Crystal Eyes Hydra
crystal_eyes.description: 50% of damage dealt by Frostfire Hydra is redealt as Arcane damage.

freezing.name: Freezing Ice
freezing.description: Frostfire Hydra's Ice beam freezes units for 2 turns.

description.en:
Deal [11_dark:dark] damage to enemy units in a [1_tile:radius] radius.
Summon ghosts at empty tiles in the radius.
Ghosts have [4_HP:minion_health], fly, [100_physical:physical] resist, [50_dark:dark] resist, and passively blink.
Ghosts have a melee attack which deals [1_dark:dark] damage.
The ghosts vanish after [14_turns:minion_duration].

haunted.name: Haunting
haunted.description:
Curses affected enemies with Haunted, which summons a ghost near them each turn.
Lasts for [10:duration] turns.

king.name: Ghost King
king.description: A Ghost King is summoned at the center of the ghost ball.

mass.name: Ghost Mass
mass.description: A Ghostly Mass is summoned at the center of the ghost ball.

description.en:
Summon a giant bear.
The bear has [75_HP:minion_health].
The bear has a melee attack which deals [10_physical:physical] damage.

armored.name: Metal Bear
armored.description: Summons a metallic bear instead of a giant bear.

venom.name: Venom Bear
venom.description: Summons a venom bear instead of a giant bear.  Venom Bears have a poison bite, and heal whenever an enemy takes poison damage.

blood.name: Blood Bear
blood.description: Summons a blood bear instead of a giant bear.  Blood bears are resistant to dark damage, and deal increasing damage with each attack.

description.en:
Summon a glass orb next to the caster.
Each turn the orb inflicts [glassify] on enemy units in a [3_tile:radius] area.
[Glassified] units cannot act.
[Glassified] units gain [-100_physical:physical] resist.
[Glassified] units gain [100_ice:ice] resist.
[Glassified] units gain [100_lightning:lightning] resist.
[Glassified] units gain [75_fire:fire] resist.

shards.name: Orb Shards
shards.description: Each turn the orb shoots out [2:num_targets] glass shards that deal [16:minion_damage] [physical] damage to random enemies in LOS

refraction.name: Enchantment Refraction
refraction.description: Glass orb recasts any self-targeted [enchantment] spell you cast.

description.en:
Gain [50_physical:physical] resist.
Gain [50_fire:fire] resist.
Gain [50_lightning:lightning] resist.
Gain [50_dark:dark] resist.
Lasts [9_turns:duration].

smiting_thorns.name: Smiting Thorns
smiting_thorns.description: Whenever you take damage from an enemy, deal [7_lightning:lightning] damage to the source.

description.en:
Deal [22_fire:fire] damage in a vertical line and [22_holy:holy] damage in a horizontal line.
[Stun] [demon] and [undead] units in the affected area.

holy_smite.name: Holy Smite
holy_smite.description: Holy Fire deals additional lightning damage on the center tile.

divine_blaze.name: Divine Blaze
divine_blaze.description: Holy Fire casts your Blazerip spell.

heaven_call.name: Heaven Call
heaven_call.description: When Holy Fire kills a unit, gain a charge of Call Seraph.

All allied units gain [50_physical:physical] resist, [50_fire:fire] resist, and [50_lightning:lightning] resist and become metallic.

Lasts [9_turns:duration].

ring_of_fire.name: Ring of Fire

radioactivity.name: Radioactive Field
radioactivity.description: Deals 50% [poison:poison] damage to enemies inside the halo.

expanding.name: Lightning Nova
expanding.description: Every turn, Lightning Halo gets +1 radius

blindcasting.name: Wall Penetration
blindcasting.description: The spires can zap enemies through walls.

toxic.name: Toxogenesis

iron.name: Mechanogenesis
iron.description: Summons an iron worm ball instead.  Iron wormballs have many resistances.

ghostly.name: Ectogenesis
ghostly.description: Summons a ghost worm ball instead.  Ghost wormballs have many resistances, are undead, and teleport.

explosive_power.name: Explosive Power
explosive_power.description: Your spells and skills also gain +2 [radius].

occult_power.name: Occult Power

Sacrifice allied units in a [4:radius] tile radius.
Increase the duration and damage bonus by the number of allies sacrificed.
Does not stack.

description.en:
All other spells gain [5_range:range].

aura.name: Vision Aura
aura.description: Mystic vision affects all allied units

overwatch.name: Overwatch

dark_dream.name: Dark Dream

electric_dream.name: Electric Dream
electric_dream.description: Upon ending, summon Spark Spirits, Thunderbirds, and Aelves based on the total damage dealt by the spell.

fever_dream.name: Fever Dream
fever_dream.description: Upon ending, summon Fire Lizards, Fire Spirits, and Flame Rifts based on the total damage dealt by the spell.

plague_horseman.name: Plague Horseman

The plants vanish after [15_turns:minion_duration].

grasping_vines.name: Grasping Vines

iron.name: Iron Prison

icy.name: Icy Prison

eternal_forest.name: Immortal Forest

ice_slimes.name: Ice Slime

electric_slimes.name: Electric Slime

blood_slimes.name: Blood Slime

essence.name: Twilight Essence

mega.name: Mega Armageddon
mega.description: Provides unit with a melee version of Mega Annihilate instead of Annihilate.

freezing.name: Flash Freeze
freezing.description: Freeze all units in affected tiles for 2 turns.

cast_icicle.name: Hailstorm

pain_aura.name: Pain Aura

vampirism.name: Vampire Golem

pistons.name: Piston Spears
pistons.description: Damage dealt by [Metallic] allies is multiplied by 4.

bone_explosion.description: Also deals [physical:physical] damage equal to half of the sacrificed unit's hp to all units within 4 tiles of the sacrificed unit.

archon_beam.name: Archon Beam
archon_beam.description: Shoots lightning along the path to the sacrificed unit, damaging enemies and shielding allies

indiscriminate_hunger.name: Indiscriminate Hunger

moonblade.name: Moonblade
moonblade.description: The Seraph deals [arcane] damage in addition to [fire] and [holy] damage with its cleave attack.

heal.name: Heal Aura
heal.description: The Seraph heals all allies within 4 tiles for 4 HP each turn.

holy_fire.name: Holy Fire Aura
holy_fire.description: The Seraph gains a damage aura, randomly dealing either [2_fire:fire] or [2_holy:holy] damage to enemies within 5 tiles each turn.

Whenever an enemy takes [physical], [fire], or [lightning] damage, the [3:num_targets] nearest enemies take that much [dark] damage.

death_power.name: Death Power

deal_poison.name: Toxic Embers

target_group.name: Mass Conductance

lightning_cleave.name: Lightning Cleave

Your [lightning] spells and skills gain the following bonuses:
+100% [num_targets:num_targets]
+100% [cascade_range:cascade_range]
+100% [radius].

cleaving_whirlwind.name: Cleaving Whirlwind
cleaving_whirlwind.description: When your spell kills its primary target, attempt to teleport to that location.

marked_for_death.name: Marked for Death
marked_for_death.description:
If a spell you cast targeting an enemy fails to kill its primary target, summon a Reaper near their location.
The Reaper will disappear if the marked target dies.

description.en:
Each turn, teleport [3_enemies:num_targets] in a [6_tile:radius] radius to random locations on the map.
Lasts [10_turns:duration].

planar_travel.name: Planar Travel
planar_travel.description: Teleported enemies take damage of a random type equal to the distance traveled.

bombs_away.name: Bombs Away
bombs_away.description:
Teleported enemies receive the Time Bomb debuff.
This effect deals [1_arcane:arcane] damage per turn.
If the debuff is removed or the unit dies, the bomb explodes, destroying walls and dealing [25_arcane:arcane] damage to all units in a [4_tile:radius] radius.

description.en:
Deals [13:damage] [dark] and [poison] damage to units in a [8_tile:radius] burst.
You are healed for half the damage dealt.

felomancy.name: Felomancy
felomancy.description: Slain targets are raised as cursed cats.

ursomancy.name: Ursomancy
ursomancy.description: Healing over the wizards max health is converted into blood bears, using up to 75 points of healing per bear.

description.en:
Invoke an earthquake with a [7_tile:radius] radius.
Each tile in the area has a 50% chance to be affected.
Enemies on affected tiles take [21_physical:physical] damage.
Walls on affected tiles are destroyed.

radius_buff.name: Aftershocks
radius_buff.description: Whenever you cast Earthquake, Earthquake gains +2 radius for [2:duration] turns.

shrapnel_quake.name: Shrapnel Quake
shrapnel_quake.description: Casts your Shrapnel Blast on affected wall tiles.

description.en:
Swap the polarity of the resistances of all other units in a [4_tile:radius] area.
[Fire] resistance is swapped with [ice].
[Lightning] resistance is swapped with [physical].
[Dark] resistance is swapped with [holy].
[Poison] resistance is swapped with [arcane].

stabilize.name: Essence Stabilizer
stabilize.description: Allies affected by the spell match the higher of each pair, rather than swapping resistances.

degrade.name: Essence Degradation
degrade.description: Enemies affected by the spell match the lower of each pair, rather than swapping resistances.

banish.name: Banishment
banish.description: Temporary creatures in the affected area are killed.

description.en:
Summon a fiery tormentor.
The tormentor has [34_HP:minion_health].
The tormentor has a burst attack dealing [7_fire:fire] damage with a [4_tile:radius] radius.
The tormentor has a lifesteal attack dealing [2_dark:dark] damage with a [2_tile:minion_range] range.
The tormentor vanishes after [40_turns:minion_duration].

metallic.name: Metallic Tormentor
metallic.description: Summons a metallic fiery tormentor instead.

mass.name: Tormenting Mass
mass.description: Summons a Fiery Tormenting Mass instead.

description.en:
Summon a Fire Drake at target square.
Fire Drakes have [45_HP:minion_health], fly, and have [100_fire:fire] resist.
Fire Drakes have a breath weapon which deals [8_fire:fire] damage.
Fire Drakes have a melee attack which deals [8_physical:physical] damage.

broodlings.name: Broodlings
broodlings.description: Summoned Fire Drakes can summon 2 Fire Lizards on a 9 turn cooldown.

dragon_mage.name: Dragon Mage
dragon_mage.description: Summoned Fire Drakes can cast your Blazerip with a 4 turn cooldown.

description.en: Deal [40_fire:fire] damage in a [8_tile:radius] burst around the caster.

meltflame.name: Melting Flame
meltflame.description: Melt walls adjacent to the blast

dawnflame.name: Bright Flame
dawnflame.description: Flame Burst deals [holy] instead of [fire], and shields allied units instead of damaging them.

spreadflame.name: Spreading Flame
spreadflame.description:
Each cast of flame burst consumes all remaining charges.
For each charge consumed, flame burst gets +1 radius and +1 damage.
Slain enemies create additional explosions with half radius and damage.

description.en:
Summon an Ice Drake at target square.
Ice Drakes have [45_HP:minion_health], fly, and have [100_ice:ice] resist.
Ice Drakes have a breath weapon which deals [8_ice:ice] damage and [freezes] units.
Ice Drakes have a melee attack which deals [8_physical:physical] damage.

broodlings.name: Broodlings
broodlings.description: Summoned Ice Drakes can summon 2 Ice Lizards on a 9 turn cooldown.

dragon_mage.name: Dragon Mage
dragon_mage.description:
Summoned Ice Drakes can cast Death Chill with an 8 turn cooldown.
This Death Chill gains all of your upgrades and bonuses.

dracolich.name: Dracolich
dracolich.description: Summons a Dracolich instead of an Ice Drake.

description.en:
Summon an ice orb next to the caster.
Each turn the orb deals [6_ice:ice] damage to enemy units in a [4_tile:radius] radius.
The orb has no will of its own, each turn it will float one tile towards the target.
The orb can be destroyed by fire damage.

freeze_damage.name: Frostgleam
freeze_damage.description: Frozen enemies in radius additionally take [arcane:arcane] damage.

summon_winter_faery.name: Faebound Orb
summon_winter_faery.description: The Orb summons an Ice Faery for every 75 damage it deals.

cast_blizzard.name: Blizzard Orb
cast_blizzard.description: Ice Orb casts your Blizzard on an 8 turn cooldown.

description.en:
Must target a frozen unit.
All other enemy units in a [5_tile:radius] radius of the target are pulled towards it, [frozen] for [2_turns:duration], and dealt [11_arcane:arcane] and [11_ice:ice] damage.

embodied.name: Embodied Vortex
embodied.description: You may cast Ice Vortex on yourself.

drake_call.name: Drake Calling
drake_call.description: If a target is killed by this spell, casts your Ice Drake spell at their location.

channel.name: Channeling
channel.description: Ice Vortex can be channeled for up to 2 turns.

description.en:
Each turn, summon [2_imps:num_summons] near the caster.
Imps have [5_HP:minion_health] and can fly.
Imps have a ranged attack dealing [3_damage:minion_damage] with a [3_tile:minion_range] range.
Each imp is either a [fire], [iron:physical], or [spark:lightning] imp.
The imps each last [11_turns:minion_duration], and this effect lasts [7_turns:duration].

metalswarm.name: Metal Swarm
metalswarm.description: Imp swarm summons copper imps instead of spark imps, tungsten imps instead of iron imps, and furnace imps instead of fire imps.

darkswarm.name: Dark Swarm
darkswarm.description: Imp swarm summons rot imps, void imps, and insanity imps instead of fire, spark, and iron imps.

description.en:
Whenever you cast a [lightning] spell, teleport to that spell's target.
Gain [100_lightning:lightning] resistance.
Gain [100_physical:physical] resistance.
This effect ends the first turn that you fail to cast a [lightning] spell.

lingering_form.name: Lingering Form
lingering_form.description: Lasts 3 turns after you cast a [lightning:lightning] spell instead of vanishing instantly.

fire_form.name: Fire Form
fire_form.description: Also works on [fire:fire] spells and gives [100_fire:fire] resist.

crackling_aura.name: Crackling Aura
crackling_aura.description: In lightning form, deal [5_lightning:lightning] damage to up to [4:num_targets] enemies in a 5 tile radius each turn.

description.en:
Create a thunderstorm with a [4_tile:radius] radius.
Each turn, each tile in the storm has a [50%_chance:strikechance] of taking [12_lightning:lightning] damage.
The storm lasts for [10_turns:duration].

All non undead allies are instantly killed and raised as bone shamblers.
Bone Shamblers have the same HP as the raised units, a quarter that much melee damage, and split into smaller shamblers on death.

fae_bones.name: Fae Bones
fae_bones.description: Arcane Allies are raised as fae bone shamblers instead of normal ones.

burning_bones.name: Burning Bones
burning_bones.description: Fire allies are raised as burning bone shamblers instead of normal ones.

bone_shards.name: Bone Shards
bone_shards.description: Each slain ally deals [7_physical:physical] damage to up to [3:num_targets] enemies in line of sight.

description.en: Retarget all allied [orbs:orb] to target tile.

orb_magnets.name: Orb Magnets
orb_magnets.description:
Allied [orbs:orb] become [Metallic].
Casts your Magnetize spell on each of your allied [orbs:orb].

orb_pulse.name: Orb Pulse
orb_pulse.description: Deal [25:damage] [arcane] damage to enemy units in a [3:radius] tile radius around each of your allied [orbs:orb].

description.en:
Whenever you take damage or spend HP to cast a spell, deal that much [dark] damage to all enemies in line of sight.
Lasts [14_turns:duration].

flesh_harvest.name: Flesh Harvest
flesh_harvest.description: For every 100 damage taken during Pain Mirror, gain a charge of Summon Flesh Fiend.

gain_resists.name: Dulled Pain
gain_resists.description: Gain 25% resist to [dark:dark], [arcane:arcane], [fire:fire], [lightning:lightning], and [physical:physical] damage during pain mirror.

description.en:
Your spells and temporary summons last an extra [5_turns:duration].
This effect lasts [20_turns:duration].

solidify.name: Reality Hold
solidify.description: On cast, temporary allies become permanent.

immutable.name: Immutable Flesh
immutable.description: You heal for half of all damage dealt to you.

description.en:
Each turn, inflict [petrify] on up to [3:num_targets] unpetrified enemy units in a [7_tile:radius] radius each turn.
[Petrified] units cannot act.
[Petrified] units gain [100_ice:ice] resist.
[Petrified] units gain [100_lightning:lightning] resist.
[Petrified] units gain [75_physical:physical] resist.
[Petrified] units gain [75_fire:fire] resist.
Lasts [6_turns:duration].

crumbling_aura.name: Crumbling Aura
crumbling_aura.description: Each turn, all petrified enemies within the aura with [16:damage] or less hp are instantly killed.

wormification.name: Wormification Aura
wormification.description:
Enemies slain while petrified within the range of the aura are raised as rock worms.
The rock worm's max HP is equal to the killed unit's.

glassify.name: Glassify
glassify.description: Turn enemies to glass instead of stone, making them take double physical damage instead of one quarter.

description.en:
Lose all debuffs.
You cannot gain new debuffs.
Lasts [6_turns:duration].

crusader.name: Crusader
crusader.description: Casting a [Holy] spell extends this buff's duration by [1_turn:duration]

aura.name: Aura of Purity
aura.description: The purity buff is also applied to allies in a [5:radius] tile radius.

description.en:
Summons a ring of giant spiders at the target, surrounded by a ring of webs.
Units blocking the spider ring are [poisoned] for [10_turns:duration].
Units blocking the web ring are [stunned] for [1_turns:duration].

turbo_toxin.name: Turbo Toxin
turbo_toxin.description: Units blocking the spider ring instantly take 30 [poison] damage.

stun_duration.name: Long Webs
stun_duration.description: Units blocking the web ring are [stunned] for [5_turns:duration].

aether_spiders.name: Aether Spiders
aether_spiders.description: Summons Aether Spiders instead of Giant Spiders.

description.en:
Gain Seal of Searing.
Whenever a unit takes [fire] damage, the seal gains that many charges.
When the seal expires, it deals [1_fire:fire] damage to all enemies in line of sight for every 5 charges it has.
The seal lasts [6_turns:duration].
Recasting the spell will expire the current seal and create a new one.

slow_burn.name: Slow Burn
slow_burn.description: On expiring and dealing damage, gain a buff that redeals half the damage, then, finally, one that deals a third of it.

chaos_seal.name: Chaos Seal
chaos_seal.description: Gains charges separately from [fire:fire], [lightning:lightning], and [physical:physical] damage, and redeals each on expiration.

fire_harvest.name: Fire Harvest
fire_harvest.description: For every 100 charges stored, summon a flame spirit.

description.en:
Summons a crew of [3:num_summons] siege golems.
The siege golems will assemble an inferno cannon, or operate one if it is within [3_tiles:range].
The inferno cannon deals [30_fire:fire] damage to units in a [3_tile:radius] radius.
The cannon will explode when destroyed, dealing [30_fire:fire] damage to units in a fixed [3_tile:radius] radius.

assistant_cannoneers.name: Assistant Cannoneers
assistant_cannoneers.description: In addition to Siege Golems, summon 5 Goblin Assistants that can repair and operate inferno cannons.

recycling.name: Recycling
recycling.description: Constructs and Metallic units killed by the Inferno Cannon's [Fire_Blast:fire] are summoned as Siege Golems.

chaos_cannon.name: Chaos Cannon
chaos_cannon.description: Instead of summoning Siege Golems, summon Chaos Siege Golems. Chaos Siege Golems make a Chaos Cannon that shoots a [Fire] projectile, a [Lightning] projectile, and a [Physical] projectile with lowered radiuses.

description.en: Steal up to [3_SH:shields] from all enemy units in line of sight.

shield_burn.name: Shield Burn
shield_burn.description: Deal 5 fire damage per shield stolen

description.en:
Deals [10:damage] [physical] damage to the target each turn for [5:duration] turns.
Their maximum health is decreased by the damage dealt, and a slime is spawned nearby.

rainbow.name: Rainbow Slimes
rainbow.description: Slimes can be of any variety, not just Green Slimes.

contagion.name: Contagion
contagion.description: Slimify will jump to the nearest enemy unit in line of sight if the affected target dies.

rapid_decomposition.name: Rapid Decomposition
rapid_decomposition.description: The damage and spawning effects are triggered any time the affected target takes damage from a slime.

description.en:
Become a pachyderm and also summon [10:num_summons] pachyderms around you.
While in pachyderm form, you can walk over enemies, knocking them away and dealing [14_physical:physical] damage to them.
Gain 50 [physical] resist in pachyderm form.
When you cast a spell, stampede form ends and all the elephants are unsummoned.

fae.name: Fae Stampede
fae.description: Summon Faetouched elephants instead of normal ones.  Gain 50 arcane resist.  [Arcane] spells do not end elephant form.

burning.name: Burning Stampede
burning.description: Summon Burning elephants instead of normal ones.  Gain 50 fire resist.  [Fire] spells do not end elephant form.

metallic.name: Metal Stampede
metallic.description: Summon Metallic elephants instead of normal ones.  Gain 25 fire and 50 lightning resist.  [Metallic] spells do not end elephant form.

description.en:
Unleashes a [8_tile:radius] burst of storm energy.
Each tile in the burst takes either [20_ice:ice] damage or [20_lightning:lightning] damage.
Units dealt ice damage are [frozen] for [4_turns:duration].
Units dealt lightning damage are [stunned] for [4_turns:duration].

grants_immunity.name: Stormshield
grants_immunity.description: Allies in radius are not affected, and instead gain [ice:ice] and [lightning:lightning] immunity for [4_turns:duration].

dual_burst.name: Dual Nova
dual_burst.description: Enemies take both [lightning] and [ice] damage instead of just one, and are both frozen and stunned.

summon_threshold.name: Spirit Nova
summon_threshold.description: Summons a Storm Spirit for every 40 damage dealt in a single cast

description.en:
Summon a storm drake at target square.
Storm drakes have [45_HP:minion_health], fly, and have [100_lightning:lightning] resist.
Storm drakes have a breath weapon which creates storm clouds that deal [8_lightning:lightning] damage.
Storm drakes have a melee attack which deals [8_physical:physical] damage.

storm_legion.name: Storm Summoning
storm_legion.description: Whenever you cast Storm Drake, up to [2:num_summons] lightning storms in line of sight of the target are converted into drakes

drake_swap.name: Drake Swap
drake_swap.description: Whenever you target a summoned Storm Drake with a lightning spell, swap places with it.

dragon_mage.name: Dragon Mage
dragon_mage.description: Summoned Storm Drakes can cast your Chain Lightning with a 16 turn cooldown.

description.en:
Whenever a living enemy dies, raise it as a skeleton.
Raised skeletons have max HP equal to that of the slain unit, and deal [5_physical:physical] damage in melee.
Skeletons of flying units can fly.
This effect lasts [20_turns:duration].

salvage.name: Junk Golems
salvage.description: Whenever an enemy constructs dies, raise it as a junk golem.

spirit_catcher.name: Elemental Spirits
spirit_catcher.description: Whenever an enemy fire, ice or lightning unit dies, a random summoned ally gains 100 resistance to that element and a ranged attack of that type.  Each ally can gain only 1 such buff.

friendly.name: Restless Minions
friendly.description: Allies can also be raised by Restless Dead

description.en: Fire a bolt from each ally dealing [6_dark:dark] damage to a random enemy in line of sight.Heal each ally for the damage dealt by the corresponding bolt.

vampire_tax.name: Vampiric Tax
vampire_tax.description: You heal for 100% of the damage dealt

refract.name: Refracting Gaze
refract.description: Each bolt bounces once to a random enemy in line of sight of the original target

description.en: Deal [25_arcane:arcane] damage and destroy walls in a beam.

voidbomber.name: Void Binding
voidbomber.description: Slain enemies are raised as void bombers

voidcurse.name: Voidcurse
voidcurse.description: Enemies in the aoe gain a stacking debuff that causes them to lose 25 [arcane] resistance

description.en:
Summon a Void Drake at target square.
Void Drakes have [45_HP:minion_health], fly, and have [100_arcane:arcane] resist.
Void Drakes have a breath weapon which deals [8_arcane:arcane] damage and melts walls.
Void Drakes have a melee attack which deals [8_physical:physical] damage.

dragon_mage.name: Dragon Mage
dragon_mage.description: Summoned Void Drakes can cast your Magic Missile with on 3 turn cooldown.

essence_drake.name: Essence Drake
essence_drake.description: Whenever a summoned Void Drake kills an enemy unit, a random temporary ally becomes permanent.

description.en:
Create a [6_tile:radius] burst of lava in a chasm.
The burst flows up to [3_tiles:radius] out of the chasm.
The lava deals [52_fire:fire] damage.

requires_los.name: Blindcasting
requires_los.description: Volcano can be cast without line of sight

wall_cast.name: Wallcano
wall_cast.description: In addition to chasms, volcano may target walls.  Doing so turns the walls into chasms

description.en:
Summons a line of ice elementals with a length of [7_tiles:num_summons].
Ice elementals have [36_HP:minion_health], [50_physical:physical] resist, [100_ice:ice] resist, [-100_fire:fire] resist, and cannot move.
Ice elementals have a ranged attack which deals [5_ice:ice] damage at a range of up to [3_tiles:minion_range].
The elementals vanish after [15_turns:minion_duration].

hungry_wall.name: Hungry Wall
hungry_wall.description: +1 minion duration whenever an enemy dies of ice damage

endless_wall.name: Endless Wall
endless_wall.description: Infinite radius, make floors out of tiles in AoE.

description.en:
Each turn, casts your Lightning Bolt at the farthest enemy in line of sight.
You cannot move or cast spells.
Gain 100 [physical] resist.
Gain 75 [fire] resist.
Gain 100 [lightning] resist.
Gain 100 [poison] resist.
Lasts [5_turns:duration]

pyrostatic_watcher.name: Pyrostatic Watcher Form
pyrostatic_watcher.description: Instead casts your Pyrostatic Pulse, gain [100_fire:fire] resist instead of 75.

void_watcher.name: Void Watcher Form
void_watcher.description: Instead casts your Void Beam, gain [100_arcane:arcane] resist.  Can fire at targets outside of line of sight.

description.en: Deal [200_dark:dark] damage to a random enemy unit.

cheater.name: Cheat Fate
cheater.description: Wheel of Death avoids shielded and dark immune enemies, and weights its target selection by current resistance adjusted hitpoints instead of uniformly.

channel.name: Channeling
channel.description: Wheel of Death can be channeled for up to 4 turns.

shared.name: Shared Misfortune
shared.description: Wheel of Death instead deals damage to [2:num_targets] targets. The damage dealt to each target is divided by the number of targets hit.

description.en:
Summon a lighting orb next to the caster.
Each turn the orb fires [3_beams:num_targets] of electricity at random enemy units in line of sight. The beams deal [6_lightning:lightning] damage.
The orb has no will of its own, each turn it will float one tile towards the target.
The orb can be destroyed by lightning damage.

final_burst.name: Final Burst
final_burst.description: Casts your Arc Lightning when it dies.

drakebirth.name: Drakebirth
drakebirth.description: Casts your Storm Drake when it dies.

pyrostatics.name: Pyrostatics
pyrostatics.description: Instead of beams of lightning, fires your Pyrostatic Pulse.

description.en:
Summon a blue lion.
Blue lions have [28_HP:minion_health], fly, have [50_arcane:arcane] resist and [50_physical:physical] resist.
Blue lions have a spell that grants [1_SH:shield] to themselves and allies in their line of sight, up to a maximum of [2_SH:shield] with a cooldown of [3_turns:duration].
Blue lions also have a melee attack which deals [7_physical:physical] damage.

holy_bolt.name: Holy Bolt
holy_bolt.description: The Blue Lion's melee attack is replaced by a range 6 holy bolt attack.

healing_light_spell.name: Shimmermane
healing_light_spell.description: The Blue Lion gains your Healing Light spell on a 7 turn cooldown.

burning_lion.name: Burning Lion
burning_lion.description: Summon a Burning Lion instead of a Blue Lion.

description.en:
Summon an Archon.
Archons have [77_HP:minion_health], [3_SH:shields], and can fly.
Archons have beam attacks which deal [14_lightning:lightning] damage to enemies and shield allies.
The Archon vanishes after [17_turns:minion_duration].

healing.name: Heal Beam
healing.description: Archon's attack heals allies it passes through.

cascade.name: Beam Arc
cascade.description: Archon's attack arcs a maximum of one time to a nearby enemy.

storm_archon.name: Storm Archon
storm_archon.description: Archon gains 50 Ice resist and its attack also deals Ice damage.

description.en: Cast each of your level 1 sorcery spells on each enemy in a cone.

cantrip_burst.name: Cantrip Burst
cantrip_burst.description: Instead of a cone, Cantrip Cascade casts in a [5_tile:radius] burst.

orb_cantrips.name: Orb Cascade
orb_cantrips.description: In addition to casting in a cone, all of your orbs cast a random known cantrip on the nearest foe in line of sight.

cast_twos.name: Evocation Amalgamation
cast_twos.description: Additionally cast one random level 2 [sorcery] spell from your spellbook on all targets.

description.en: Deals [21_ice:ice] damage and inflicts [6_turns:duration] of [frozen] on units in a [3_tile:radius] wide line perpendicular to the caster.

refresh_conjuration.name: Ice Guardians
refresh_conjuration.description: For each 100 damage dealt by a single cast, gain a charge of a random ice conjuration spell.

mirror.name: Dual Wind
mirror.description: Chill Wind also affects a symmetric area behind the caster.

cast_blazerip.name: Arcane Storm
cast_blazerip.description: On kill, Chill Wind casts your Blazerip spell.

description.en:
Deal [17_lightning:lightning] damage and [17_dark:dark] damage to the target.
If the target is slain, this effect bounces to a random enemy in line of sight up to [5_tiles:range] away.

fire.name: Fire Shock
fire.description: After dealing [dark] and [lightning] damage, deals [fire] damage as well

corpse.name: Corpse Construct
corpse.description: If Death Shock kills one or more enemies, summon an electric zombie with hp equal to half the total hp of all slain enemies.

description.en:
Summons a group of [5:num_summons] faeries near the caster.
The faeries fly, and have [9_HP:minion_health], [1_SH:shields], [75_arcane:arcane] resistance, and a passive blink.
The faeries can heal allies for [5_HP:heal], with a range of [4_tiles:minion_range].
The faeries have a [4_arcane:arcane] damage attack, with a range of [4_tiles:minion_range].
The faeries vanish after [15_turns:minion_duration].

winter_fae.name: Winter Faery
winter_fae.description: Summon winter faeries instead of normal ones. Winter faeries resist ice and can cast your Freeze spell on a 5 turn cooldown.

summon_queen.name: Summon Queen
summon_queen.description: A fae queen is summoned as well

glass_fae.name: Glass Faery
glass_fae.description: Summon glass faeries instead of normal ones.

description.en:
Summons a Fleshy Mass.
Fleshy Masses have [431_HP:minion_health] and regenerate 21 HP per turn.
Fleshy Masses have a melee attack which deals [19_physical:physical] damage.

belly_flop.name: Belly Flop
belly_flop.description: Gains a [25:damage] damage leap attack with a 7 turn cooldown.

char_fiend.name: Barbeque Fiends
char_fiend.description: Summons burning flesh fiends instead of normal ones.

worm_lord.name: Worm Lord
worm_lord.description: Flesh Fiends can cast your Lumbriogenesis spell on a 13 turn cooldown.

description.en:
Summons [3_eagles:num_summons] near the caster.
Eagles have [18_HP:minion_health] and can fly.
Eagles have a melee attack which deals [6_physical:physical] damage.
Eagles also have a [5_tile:range] leap attack which deals [6_physical:physical] damage.

thunderbirds.name: Thunder Claw
thunderbirds.description: Eagles gain your Thunder Strike spell on a 15 turn cool down.

awe.name: Untouchable Majesty
awe.description: Eagles deal 1 [holy] damage to anyone dealing them damage.

description.en:
Summons a golden skull.
Golden skulls are teleporting, floating, shielded stationary units.
Golden skulls have a [holy] beam attack and a single target healing spell.

ghost_ball.name: Ghost Caller
ghost_ball.description: The Golden Skull gains your Ghostball spell with a 6 turn cooldown

wheel.name: Bone Wheel
wheel.description: The Golden Skull gains your Wheel of Death spell with a 12 turn cooldown

bloodshift.name: Blood Skull
bloodshift.description: The Golden Skull gains your Bloodshift spell with a 3 turn cooldown

description.en:
Summon an Idol of Beauty.
The idol has [35_HP:minion_health], [2_SH:shields], and is stationary.
The idol has a passive aura which affects all units in line of sight of the idol each turn.
Affected allies are healed for [1_HP:heal].
Affected enemies take [1_holy:holy] damage.
Affected [undead] and [demon] units take an additional [1_lightning:lightning] damage.
The idol vanishes after [15_turns:minion_duration].

fire_gaze.name: Fire Gaze
fire_gaze.description: The Idol gains a fire beam attack

shield_gaze.name: Shield Gaze
shield_gaze.description: The Idol gains a single-target +4 SH ability, which sets the SH of a unit with less than 4 SH to 4 SH.

immortality.name: Bastion of Immortality
immortality.description: Casts your Suspend Mortality on summoned ally units with a 5 turn cooldown

description.en:
Summon an ice phoenix.
The phoenix has [74_HP:minion_health], flies, and reincarnates once upon death.
The phoenix has a ranged attack which deals [9_ice:ice] damage with a [4_tile:minion_range] range.
When the phoenix dies, it explodes in a [6_tile:radius] burst, freezing enemies for 4 turns and dealing them [25_ice:ice] damage, and granting [2_SH:shields] to allies.

lives.name: Reincarnations
lives.description: The phoenix will reincarnate 2 more times

ice_aura.name: Ice Aura
ice_aura.description: The phoenix gains 2 damage ice aura with a 6 tile radius

heal_aura.name: Heal Aura
heal_aura.description: The phoenix gains a 1 hp regen aura with a 6 tile radius

description.en: Deals [99_fire:fire] damage, [99_lightning:lightning] damage, and [99_physical:physical] damage to the target.

cascade_range.name: Cascade
cascade_range.description: Remaining hits from Mega Annihilate will jump to nearby targets if the main target is killed

crystal.name: Crystal Annihilation
crystal.description: Mega Annihilate deals additional [ice] and [holy] damage hits

giant_slayer.name: Giant Slayer
giant_slayer.description: Mega Annihilate deals its damage to every tile of multi-tile units.

description.en:
Summon a Night Hag.
Night Hags can summon ghosts and drain HP from all living units in line of sight when they are wounded.

bone_spear.name: Spear Hag
bone_spear.description: The Night Hag gains your Bone Spear spell on a 4 turn cooldown

nightmare.name: Nightmare Hag
nightmare.description: The Night hag can cast your Nightmare Aura spell

bone_lady.name: Bone Queen
bone_lady.description: The Night Hag gains the ability to summon [2:num_summons] small bone shamblers

description.en:
Deal [50_fire:fire] in a [1_tile:radius] burst.
Deal double damage to the center tile.

channel.name: Channeling
channel.description: Pillar of Flame becomes a channeled spell

disruption.name: Disrupting Flames
disruption.description: Strips main target of shields and applies -50 [Fire] resist for [10:duration] turns.

cast_annihilate.name: Pillar of Annihilation
cast_annihilate.description: On kill, casts your Annihilate spell on up to [4:num_targets] enemy units in line of sight of the target tile.

description.en:
Summon an slime orb next to the caster.
Each turn the orb summons a slime next to enemy units in a [4_tile:radius] radius.
The orb has no will of its own, each turn it will float one tile towards the target.
The orb can be destroyed by dark damage.

adaptive.name: Adaptive Slime
adaptive.description: Slime Orb will attempt to summon the type of slime that enemies are weakest to, rather than a Green Slime.

explosive_growth.name: Explosive Growth
explosive_growth.description: Slime Orb will summon [3:num_summons] slimes instead of just 1 per enemy.

orb_walk.name: Orb Detonation
orb_walk.description:
Targeting an existing slime orb detonates it.
Deals [100:damage] [poison] damage in a [4:radius] tile burst.
Summons a Green Slime Cube in the orb's location.

description.en:
Deal damage to target unit equal to one third of its health as [holy] damage, and then one third of its remaining health as [dark] damage.
Heal the caster for the total amount of damage dealt.

arcane.name: Arcane Taxation
arcane.description: Soul tax deals an additional third of the target's remaining HP as arcane damage.

quick_cast.name: Insta Tax
quick_cast.description: Casting Soul Tax only takes half a turn

target_group.name: Mass Taxation
target_group.description: Targets a connected group of enemies.

description.en:
Summon a spider queen.
The spider queen has [96_HP:minion_health].
The spider queen hatches [4:num_summons] baby spiders every [12_turns:duration].
Baby spiders have [3_HP:minion_health] and prefer to flee than attack, but they mature into giant spiders after [8_turns:duration] which have [14_HP:minion_health].
Giant spiders and the spider queen have melee attacks which deal [2_physical:physical] physical damage and inflicts 10 turns of [poison].

aether.name: Aether Queen
aether.description: Summon an aether spider queen instead.

steel.name: Steel Queen
steel.description: Summon a steel spider queen instead.

description.en: Teleport to target tile.

quick_cast.name: Quickcast
quick_cast.description: Casting Teleport only takes half a turn.

group_teleport.name: Group Teleport
group_teleport.description: Teleport also teleports up to [10:num_targets] ally units with you.

void_teleport.name: Void Teleport
void_teleport.description: Teleport deals arcane damage to all enemy units in line of sight of the targeted tile equal to its maximum number of charges.

description.en:
Lightning arcs to [4_enemies:num_targets] visible from the target tile.
Each arc deals [32_lightning:lightning] damage to units in a beam.
Then, this process repeats once for half damage at each targeted enemy.

arcane_arcs.name: Proton Storm
arcane_arcs.description: Arc Lightning deals [4_arcane:arcane] damage to all units in line of sight of each arc target

enervation.name: Enervation
enervation.description: Arc Lightning heals allies instead of damaging them

description.en:
All allied dragons gain [25_max_HP:minion_health], [12:damage] attack damage, and [1_turn:duration] cooldown reduction on their breath weapon attacks.
This buff stacks and lasts for [25_turns:duration].

vitality.name: Draconic Vitality
vitality.description: Dragons also gain 6 HP regen for the duration.

vigor.name: Draconic Vigor
vigor.description: Dragons gain +2 range to their breath attack

majesty.name: Draconic Majesty
majesty.description: On cast, all enemy units adjacent to your dragon minions are stunned for [5_turns:duration].

description.en:
For [10:duration] turns, whenever you deal 50 or more [lightning] or [arcane] damage, summon a butterfly demon.
Butterfly demons fly and have [50_HP:minion_health] and [3_SH:shields].
Butterfly demons have [lightning] and [arcane] beam attacks which deal [7_lightning:lightning] and [9_arcane:damage], both with a range of [6_tiles:minion_range]. The arcane beam can melt through walls.
Butterfly demons are immune to [lightning], [arcane] and [dark] damage, but take 50% extra damage from [ice] and double damage from [holy].
Butterfly demons last [8_turns:minion_duration].

gnomes.name: Guardian Gnomes
gnomes.description: Summon [6:num_summons] electric gnomes on casting faehaunt garden.

flies.name: Fae Flies
flies.description: Summon a Fae Fly Swarm every 15 damage.

glass.name: Glass Garden
glass.description: Summon Glass Butterflies instead of Butterfly Demons.

description.en:
Summons a crucible of pain which summons furnace hounds whenever you deal 100 damage with [sorcery].
Furnace hounds have a [6_damage:damage] leap attack with a [4_tile:minion_range] range, a [1_fire:fire] damage aura with a [4_tile:radius] radius, and deal [4_fire:fire] damage to enemies that attack them in melee.
Furnace hounds are immune to [fire] and [lightning] damage, and take half damage from [physical] and [dark].
Furnace hounds take double damage from [holy] and 50% extra damage from [ice].

flames.name: Flames of Sorcery
flames.description: The furnace can cast your Flame Burst spell on a 5 turn coodlown.

smithy.name: Imp Smithy
smithy.description: The furnace also produces an Copper Imp every 30 damage.

lasers.name: Arcane Eyebolts
lasers.description: The hounds can cast your magic missile spell on a 4 turn cooldown.

description.en:
Summon a Gold Drake.
Gold drakes have [45_HP:minion_health], [100_holy:holy] resist, and can fly.
Gold drakes have a breath weapon which deals [8_holy:holy] damage to enemies and heals allies for [8_HP:heal].
Gold drakes have a melee attack which deals [8_physical:physical] damage

dragon_mage.name: Dragon Mage
dragon_mage.description:
Summoned Gold Drakes can cast Healing Light with a 8 turn cooldown.
This Healing Light gains all of your upgrades and bonuses.

dragon_saint.name: Dragon Saint
dragon_saint.description: Deals 14 [holy_damage:holy] to anything that deals damage to the Gold Drake.

immortal_dragon.name: Immortal Dragon
immortal_dragon.description: Gold Drake gains the Immortal modifier.

description.en:
Deal [22_lightning:lightning] damage and [22_holy:holy] damage to [3_units:num_targets] with the highest current HP.
Does not target friendly units or gates.

culling.name: Culling
culling.description: Heaven's Wrath also damages the units with the lowest current HP.

stun_duration.name: Halt Heretics
stun_duration.description: Heaven's Wrath also applies Stun for [3_turns:duration].

deal_fire.name: Fiery Wrath
deal_fire.description: Heaven's Wrath also deals fire damage.

description.en:
Summon a void knight, a chaos knight, and a storm knight.
Each knight has [90_HP:minion_health], various resistances, and an arsenal of unique magical abilities.
The caster takes [40_holy:holy] damage whenever a knight dies.

void_court.name: Void Court
void_court.description: Summon only void knights.  Summon a void champion as well.

storm_court.name: Storm Court
storm_court.description: Summon only storm knights.  Summon a storm champion as well.

chaos_court.name: Chaos Court
chaos_court.description: Summon only chaos knights.  Summon a chaos champion as well.

description.en: While channeling, regain a charge of a random other spell. Channels for 5 turns.

distant_memory.name: Distant Memory
distant_memory.description: Prioritize regaining charges of depleted spells.

memory_shield.name: Shield of Memories
memory_shield.description: Gain 2 SH each time you gain charges from this spell.

description.en:
Summon a searing orb next to the caster.
The orb deals [3_fire:fire] damage each turn to all units in line of sight.
The caster is immune to this damage.
The orb has no will of its own, each turn it will float one tile towards the target.
The orb can be destroyed by ice damage.

explosive.name: Explosive Orb
explosive.description: Searing Orb casts your Flameburst on expiration.

melt_walls.name: Matter Melting
melt_walls.description: Searing Orb can melt and be cast through walls

flame_rift.name: Flame Rift
flame_rift.description: For each 20 damage dealt by an orb, summon a flame rift for [10_turns:minion_duration] near the orb.

description.en:
All enemies in line of sight lose [50_dark:dark] resist and [50_holy:holy] resist.
Lasts [10_turns:duration].

piercing_gaze.name: Piercing Gaze
piercing_gaze.description: Twlight Gaze affects all enemies, not just those in light of sight.

description.en:
Whenever you cast a [sorcery] spell, copy it.
Lasts [3_turns:duration]

spell_weaving.name: Spell Weaving
spell_weaving.description: Your non-sorcery spells gain quickcast for the duration of the buff.

description.en:
Casts your thunderstrike spell targeting [12:num_targets] random Storm Clouds each turn.
Clouds with enemies in them are prioritized over ones without.
Will not target allies or the Wizard.
This spell can be channeled for up to [12_turns:duration].  The effect is repeated each turn the spell is channeled.

dragons.name: Tempest Drakes
dragons.description: Each strike has a 25% chance of casting your storm drake spell as well

all_weather.name: Cryostorm
all_weather.description: May instead cast your Iceball on Blizzards or Rain Clouds

stormbringer.name: Stormbringer
stormbringer.description: Each turn you channel this spell, summons [12:num_summons] Storm Clouds across the map.

description.en:
Invokes a soul wind.  All units in a [3_tile:radius] wide line perpendicular to the caster take [37_dark:dark] damage.
All [undead], [dark], and [demon] units in the area take [37_holy:holy] damage instead.
Summons a spirit from each [Living] unit in the area.
The spirits may have extra abilities and resistances based on the tags of the units they originated from.

arcane_wind.name: Arcane Wind
arcane_wind.description: Also deals [arcane] damage to all units in the area of effect

mirror.name: Dual Wind
mirror.description: Soul Wind also casts behind the caster.

ensoulment.name: Ensoulment
ensoulment.description: Spawn ghosts from non [living] units as well

description.en: Surrounds the caster with spikeball gates, which will spawn spikeballs.

defense.name: Defense System
defense.description: The summoned lairs gain a projectile attack with 10 range that deals [5_physical:physical] damage.

manufactory.name: Manufactory
manufactory.description: Surrounds the initially summoned gates with another layer of gates

copper.name: Copper Spikeballs
copper.description: Summons copper spikeballs instead of normal ones

description.en:
Heal yourself and all living units fully.
Deal [25_lightning:lightning] damage to [demon] and [undead] units.
[Stun] all [arcane] units for [7_turns:duration].

shield_strip.name: Shield Strip
shield_strip.description: Damaged units lose 1 SH before being damaged.

description.en:
[Stun] each enemy for [6_turns:duration] and teleport them to random tiles.
Deal [45_lightning:lightning] damage to all [fire] enemies.
Deal [45_fire:fire] damage to all [lightning] enemies.
Each enemy construct loses all [physical] resist and takes [45_physical:physical] damage.

reanimation.name: Animated Chaos
reanimation.description: Slain units are reanimated as Chaos Spirits.

chaos_gifts.name: Infernal Gifts
chaos_gifts.description: Up to [3:num_targets] random non-chaos allies get the infernal boss modifier.

description.en:
All non [ice] immune enemies are [frozen] for [5_turns:duration].
Deals [50_ice:ice] damage to all fire units.

endless_ice.name: Endless Ice
endless_ice.description: Gain a charge of all other ice spells on cast.

word_of_wind.name: Word of Wind
word_of_wind.description: Casts your Chill Wind on up to [3:num_targets] enemies.

description.en:
[Berserk] all units except the caster for [5_turns:duration].
Deal [dark] damage to all [construct] units equal to half their current HP.
Fully heal all [demon] and [arcane] units.

guardians.name: Guardians of Madness
guardians.description: Summon [3:num_summons] mind devourers, [5:num_summons] floating eyeballs, and [6:num_summons] troublers for 10 turns at random locations.

description.en:
All undead units have their current and maximum HP doubled.
All other units except the caster lose half their current and maximum HP.

hatred_of_life.name: Hatred of Life
hatred_of_life.description: All other [living:living] units take [36:poison] poison damage.

spirit_gift.name: Spirit Gift
spirit_gift.description: Up to [3:num_targets] allies (excluding [undead]) get the ghostly modifier.

spirit_lich.name: Spirit of Lichdom
spirit_lich.description: Up to [3:num_targets] random [living:living] allies get the lich modifier.

description.en:
Summons [4:num_summons] Wyrm eggs near the caster.
Each egg will hatch into either a [fire] or an [ice] wyrm on death.

magic_eggs.name: Magic Eggs
magic_eggs.description: Fire eggs cast your Fireball on a 3 turn cooldown, and Ice eggs cast your Icicle on a 3 turn cooldown.

radiant_eggs.name: Radiant Eggs
radiant_eggs.description: Wyrm Eggs gain a 1 damage [3_radius:radius] aura of their element type.

description.en:
Summon a Starwhale.  Channel for up to 20 turns, unsummon the starwhale and freeze yourself for 3 turns afterwards.
Gain 100% [ice] and [arcane] damage resistance while channeling this spell.

starhost.name: Starhost
starhost.description: The whale gains the ability to summon [2:num_summons] starswimmers for [10:minion_duration] turns on a 6 turn cooldown

icedream.name: Ice Dream
icedream.description: The whale's aura applies freeze for [2:duration] turns

starbask.name: Starbask
starbask.description: You and the whale heal for 50% of all [arcane] damage dealt during the channel

description.en: Summons an Aelf spawner at a random location.

aelf_horde.name: Aelf Horde
aelf_horde.description: The spawn time is shortened to 4 to 5 turns instead.

fae_aelves.name: Fae Aelves
fae_aelves.description: The Spawners spawn Fae Aelves instead of normal Aelves.

elite_aelves.name: Elite Aelves
elite_aelves.description: The Spawners spawn Aelf Lightning Artists instead of normal Aelves.

description.en:
Fires bolts at [4:num_targets] random enemies each turn, alternatingly dealing [14_fire:fire] or [14_dark:dark] damage to all units on the path.
Can be channeled for up to 5 turns.Afterwards, all remaining enemies deal 2 [fire] or [dark] damage to the caster.

return.name: Boomerang
return.description: The bolts also return after they reach their target, damaging units in the middle a second time.

harvest.name: Torment Harvest
harvest.description: If this spell kills an enemy, gain a charge of Summon Fiery Tormentor

description.en: Summons [5:num_summons] Satyr and [5:num_summons] Minotaurs.

Deals either [7_arcane:arcane] or [7_lightning:lightning] damage the nearest [1:num_targets] enemies each turn.
Number of targets increases by 1 each turn for the first half of the duration, and decreases by 1 each turn for the second half.
Lasts [14_turns:duration].

growing_power.name: Growing Power
growing_power.description: The damage dealt also increases by [1:damage] each turn for the first half of the duration, and decreases by [1:damage] each turn for the second half.

bloody_tendrils.name: Bloody Tendrils
bloody_tendrils.description: Damage dealt by the spell heals the caster for 50% of the damage dealt.

cthulhu.name: Cthulhu Form
cthulhu.description: Increase the starting number of targets by 1 for each [Eye] spell you know.

description.en:
Channel the Ritual of Revelation for [7_turns:duration].
Each turn while you channel the ritual, Holy Fire will be cast for free on [3:num_targets] enemy units in line of sight.
If not enough enemy units are in line of sight, you or an ally will be targeted as well.
Units will never be targeted more than once.When the channel is complete, [7:num_summons] False Prophets will be summoned.

arcane_revelation.name: Arcane Revelation
arcane_revelation.description: Also casts your Blazerip on [3:num_targets] enemies.

description.en: Summon a Slime Drake

infernal.name: Infernal Drake
infernal.description: Slime Drake gets the Infernal boss modifier.

dragon_mage.name: Dragon Mage
dragon_mage.description: Slime Drake can cast your Slimeshot with a 6 turn cooldown.

oozing_trail.name: Oozing Trail
oozing_trail.description: When the Slime Drake moves, it will attempt to summon a Slime nearby.

description.en: Summons a random wizard.

jealousy.name: Jealousy
jealousy.description: When you cast this spell, an enemy wizard in line of sight of the summoned wizard becomes your ally.

dragon_wizard.name: Dragon Wizard
dragon_wizard.description: You always summon the Dragon Wizard.

mutant_wizard.name: Mutant Wizard
mutant_wizard.description: A random boss modifier is applied to the summoned wizard.

description.en:
Casts your fireball spell targeting [9:num_targets] random tiles in a [7_tile:radius] radius each turn.
This spell can be channeled for up to [10_turns:duration].  The effect is repeated each turn the spell is channeled.

chaos.name: Chaos Storm
chaos.description: Each meteor casts your Annihilate on [3:num_targets] enemy units within [4:radius] tiles

dragons.name: Rain of Dragons
dragons.description: Each meteor has a 25% chance of casting your fire drake spell as well

pyrostatic.name: Pyrostatic Storm
pyrostatic.description: Each meteor casts your Lightning Bolt on up to [2:num_targets] enemies in line of sight

description.en: Forges a living replica of the wizard and their equipment.

reclamation.name: Blood Reclamation
reclamation.description: If the Wizard Replica dies, the charge cost is refunded.

idolatry.name: Wizard Colossus
idolatry.description:
Rather than a mortal sized Wizard Replica, you create a Colossus.
 A giant immobile version of the Wizard Replica, whose health and melee damage are multiplied by the number of equipments you own.

investiture.name: Investiture
investiture.description: The Wizard Replica gains up to three of your cantrips and can cast each of them on a 3 turn cooldown.
